verdict.rationale: Rippling documents flagging potential labor-policy risks based on each employee's work location so managers can act before payroll, which is a proactive location-driven compliance alert. It also offers custom workflows that notify people of important changes. The evidence does not show alerts tied to new hires creating obligations (e.g., new state registrations) or to law changes. Missing for 10: proactive alerts when a new hire triggers new tax or registration obligations, notifications of legislative or law changes, compliance-specific alerting beyond time-and-attendance labor policies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
